channel.title: Gopetrel Precision - Engineering Notes
channel.description: Precision CNC machining and fabrication - milling, turning, 5-axis, EDM and sheet metal, with inspection reports that travel with the parts.

item.title: Handheld vs Robotic Laser Welding: Which One Should Your Shop Buy?
item.description: A buyer's guide to choosing between a handheld fiber laser welder and a robotic laser welding cell - where each pays off, what the decision turns on, and when a shop runs both.

item.title: Thread Production: Tapping, Thread Milling or Thread Rolling
item.description: Tapping, thread milling and thread rolling produce a thread three different ways. How the choice changes strength, tolerance, tool life and cost.

item.title: Heat Treatment and Hardness: What to Specify and When to Machine
item.description: Hardness numbers, heat-treatment sequence and distortion: what to put on the drawing, and why the order of machining and treatment decides the tolerance.

item.title: Designing Machined Parts for Tool Access
item.description: A feature a cutter cannot reach is a feature that costs money or cannot be made at all. How tool reach, pocket depth and radii decide the price of a part.

item.title: From Prototype to Production: What Changes When a Machined Part Scales
item.description: The design that worked as a prototype is not automatically the design that ships. What changes at volume, and which decisions should be made before tooling.

item.title: Fastener and Fitting Selection for Machined Assemblies
item.description: Threads, inserts, clearance fits and standard versus custom fittings: how to specify the joints that hold a machined assembly together.

item.title: Planning a Robotic Laser Welding Cell: Throughput, Joint Access and Payback
item.description: A laser welding cell is a robot plus a positioner, source, enclosure and fixtures. Plan it around cycle time and access, not brochure power.

item.title: First Article Inspection: What to Expect and Why It Pays
item.description: What an FAI actually verifies, what to send with it, and how to read the report when dimensions miss.

item.title: Surface Finish Ra Values Explained
item.description: What Ra actually measures, which values are realistic from which process, and when a finish spec is wasted.

item.title: How to Read a CNC Quote (and Compare Two of Them)
item.description: What a machining quote is actually telling you, and how to compare quotes that look different.

item.title: A DFM Checklist to Run Before You Order Parts
item.description: Twelve checks that catch most manufacturability problems before they reach the machine shop.

item.title: Choosing a Finish for Machined Hardware
item.description: Corrosion, wear, appearance and cost: how to pick a finish for machined metal components.

item.title: Laser Welding for Sheet-Metal Assemblies
item.description: When laser welding beats TIG or spot welding on a sheet-metal assembly, and what to design for.

item.title: CNC or Injection Moulding? Finding the Crossover
item.description: Volume, geometry and material decide whether machining or moulding is the better route for a plastic part.

item.title: How to Set Machining Tolerances Without Overpaying
item.description: Set tolerances feature by feature so you only pay for the precision the part actually needs.
